data.text: I’ll commit to 15 tons and donate the full $15,000 to the clinic, provided John, Kate, and Jack also commit to 15 each and Luke to zero. My family taught me to protect this lake, but protecting our neighbors matters too. The verified emergency justifies this one-time drawdown—not a new catch limit. I also commit to 6 tons next month under the proposed recovery plan, then 10 each once the lake is back at 100. John, can you confirm both your donation and the recovery limits?
